title: AnomalyPulse experiment manifest
description: Ground-truth record of one simulator run, stored at experiments/<experiment_id>/manifest.json. Every field is Tier-2: nothing in a manifest may enter the feature matrix.

experiment_id.description: exp-<UTC start time>-<4 hex>. Not a sequence number; the M4 registry assigns those.

status.description: RUNNING is written when the run starts; the manifest is rewritten with a final status when it ends. A manifest still at RUNNING after its run is a run that died.

incident_type.description: Intended experiment-level label. Per-window labels are derived from activations in M4. A confounder run is a single-fault type with more than one activation.

severity.description: Derived from the highest activation intensity: LOW below 1/3, MEDIUM below 2/3, HIGH otherwise. Intensity is a position within its band, so severity does not compare magnitude across bands. Null for NORMAL.

seed.description: RNG seed the resolved params were drawn with. Kept within 32 bits so numpy accepts it.

workload.description: Baseline workload settings for the run. Open: the workload generator owner defines the keys.

activations.description: One entry per injected fault. Empty for NORMAL. Overlapping windows record which faults were concurrently active.

telemetry.description: Where this run's telemetry lives. The run's slice is everything under these prefixes between started_at and ended_at.

fault_id.description: <experiment_id>#<n>. Same value as the fault-config item when the injector uses the control plane.

injector.description: Registry name of the injector that produced this activation.

target.description: Service the fault is applied to. Null when the fault has no single service target (a traffic spike).

intensity.description: Normalized 0-1 position requested within the band.

parameter.description: Native parameter the band is expressed in, e.g. timeout_ms.

band.description: The band the intensity was mapped onto.

params.description: Resolved native values the injector applied. Open: the injector owner defines the keys.

observed.description: Outcomes the injector measured during the run, e.g. a throttle count. Empty until the run ends. Open: the injector owner defines the keys. Unlike params, these do not repeat from the seed.

active_from.description: Start of the fault window, inclusive.

active_until.description: End of the fault window, exclusive.
